label: Town of Cabot
header:
# Town of Cabot municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 4; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Cabot Selectboard members: Walter (Skip) Bothfeld, Frederick Ducharme, Michael Hogan (Vice Chair), Peggy Miller, and Jennifer Miner (Chair).
Town of Cabot official website, Selectboard page: lists Jennifer Miner (Chair), Michael Hogan (Vice Chair), Peggy Miller, Fred Ducharme, and Walter (Skip) Bothfeld, Jr.
Town of Cabot official website, Town Officers page: lists Town Clerk Brittany Butler, term expires 2029.
Town of Cabot, Selectboard meeting minutes (June 4, 2026): signed 'Respectfully Submitted, Brittany Butler, Town Clerk'.
Town of Cabot, Selectboard meeting minutes (July 7, 2026): signed by Brittany Butler as Town Clerk.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Betty Ritter as Town Clerk of Cabot; Ritter signed the town's minutes through late 2025 and Butler signs them from spring 2026 -- the January 2026 Guide is superseded by the town's current records.

Town of Cabot, Selectboard meeting minutes (July 7, 2026): record the Selectboard Chair signing a three-year contract for Town Treasurer Amy Monahan -- the treasurer serves under contract with the Selectboard, not by election.
Town of Cabot official website, Town Officers page: lists Town Treasurer Amy Monahan with term 'Non-Term'.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Amy Monahan as Treasurer of Cabot.

Town of Cabot official website, Town Officers page: lists Moderator Jeanne Johnson with a printed term expiration of 2024. No official source publishes the outcome of a later election for the seat, so it is left unfilled. Structure only.

Town of Cabot official website, Town Officers page: lists Listers Brittany Butler (printed term 2026), Jeanne Johnson (no term printed), and Jacqueline Lumbra (printed term 2026). The printed terms have run out and no official source publishes the current holders, so the seats are left unfilled. Structure only.

Town of Cabot official website, Town Officers page: lists Delinquent Tax Collector Susan Carpenter with a printed term expiration of 2025; the town fills the office separately, so the post is created under 17 V.S.A. section 2651d. No official source publishes the current holder, so the seat is left unfilled. Structure only.
Town of Cabot official website, Town Officers page: lists Grand Juror Dave Pike with a printed term expiration of 2025. No official source publishes the current holder, so the seat is left unfilled.
17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a grand juror at annual town meeting.

Town of Cabot official website, Town Officers page: lists five Cemetery Commissioners -- Deb Bothfeld, Ruth Goodrich, Angela Ward, Melvin Churchill (Chair), and Cedric Alexander -- with printed term expirations of 2025 and 2026. All of the printed terms have run out and no official source publishes the current holders, so the seats are left unfilled. Structure only.

Town of Cabot, Selectboard meeting minutes (March 10, 2026): the Selectboard's annual appointments table appoints Stephen Hogan as 1st Constable (three-year term to 2029). He is a distinct person from Selectboard member Michael Hogan.
Town of Cabot, Selectboard meeting minutes (March 10, 2026): the Selectboard's annual appointments table appoints Nell McQuenney as 2nd Constable (three-year term to 2029).

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Cabot justices of the peace: Susan Carpenter, Fred Ducharme, Cedric Alexander, Caleb Pitkin, Carla Payne, Roman Kokodyniak, and Judy Pransky.
Town of Cabot official website, Justice of the Peace page: names the same seven justices of the peace.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Cabot justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term; they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office. The listing publishes no vote totals and no party designations for justices of the peace.
